messages:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — during last week's onboarding calls three customers surfaced overlapping asks that look product-ish rather than onboarding docs. Short summary: 1) per-route cost breakdown missing (sees only aggregate) — quote: 'We can't tell which feature is eating our credits'. 2) SSO role mapping UX is confusing for admins — 'roles map to weird internal names'. 3) webhook retry behavior and dead-lettering unclear across Dedicated/Private. Attaching snippets below.

Liam Green: Thanks Priya. Can you paste the raw quotes + customer severity (high/med/low)? I can loop in the PM triage tomorrow.

Priya Rao: Pasted two quick quotes: 
- Acme Retail: 'We had to guess which route was expensive — billing is a blackbox' (severity: high, renewal at-risk if cost isn't visible).
- HealthKit: 'Our security lead couldn't map SSO roles to our AD groups' (severity: medium).
- FinWave: 'Webhook retries are firing repeatedly; we need DLQ + backoff' (severity: high).

Aria Soto: This is helpful. Can we add an impact metric? e.g., #customers_affected, estimated monthly $ impact, uptime/regulatory blockers. If possible please tag customer ARR. I'll slot into next product planning.

Noah Tran: Proposal for quick prioritization rubric (2-min):
- Customer count (0-3)
- Revenue impact (0-3)
- Implementation effort (0-3, dev estimate)
- Risk to renew (0-3)
Then score out of 12, >8 urgent. Thoughts?

Olivia Kim: Raw export from NPS/onboarding notes CSV here: https://redwood.internal/s3/cs-exports/1823_onboard_feedback.csv 
Also quick notes: Acme Retail = $180k ARR, HealthKit = $45k, FinWave = $300k.

Priya Rao: Added preliminary scores inline: Acme (customers=1,revenue=3,effort=2,renewal=3) -> 9. FinWave -> 10. HealthKit -> 5.

Aria Soto: Good, FinWave + Acme look urgent. Noah — can you pull a rough dev estimate for per-route cost UI and webhook DLQ complexity? Prefer a one-week spike vs full project?

Noah Tran: I'll ask infra + runtime team. Quick gut: per-route cost UI = spike 3d + 2w dev (frontend + analytics); webhook DLQ = spike 2d + 1w dev + infra config. Will confirm.

Liam Green: I'll draft a short customer comms template for Acme/FinWave with interim mitigation (manual cost exports + webhook retry guards). Ping me if you want me on calls.

Priya Rao: Also flagging enablement: we should update onboarding checklist and SSO doc once PMs confirm scope. Assigning Olivia to update docs after triage.

Olivia Kim: Got it — will prepare a short SSO admin guide and a 'how to export per-route cost' playbook once we have acceptance criteria.

cs-feedback-bot: New feedback thread recorded: id=fb-20260314-1823456789, linked customers=[Acme Retail, HealthKit, FinWave], severity_high=2, items=[per-route-cost, sso-role-mapping, webhook-dlq].

Aria Soto: Next steps: (1) Noah confirm dev estimates by EOD Tue, (2) Priya confirm ARR + customer contacts, (3) Liam prepare comms + mitigation, (4) I'll put feature candidates into next planning board.

Liam Green: Quick Q — should we run a short customer poll asking which of these matters most? could be a 1-question NPS-style ask. Recommend doing after we confirm scope.

Priya Rao: Agreed. I'll wait for dev estimates then run a 2-option poll with Acme + FinWave.

Noah Tran: Update — dev estimates incoming, will post separate thread with tech notes and rough timeline.

Olivia Kim: +1 on timing. If anyone wants the raw CSV exported as a Slack snippet let me know.

Priya Rao: Thanks all — tagging @Aria @Noah @Liam for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
